pages.text: Apache Kafka is a distributed event streaming platform. Producers publish records to topics, and consumers subscribe to topics to read those records in order. Kafka stores records durably on disk and replicates them across brokers for fault tolerance.

Apache Spark is a unified analytics engine for large-scale data processing. Spark processes data in memory using resilient distributed datasets, which makes iterative jobs fast. Spark SQL lets you query structured data with SQL.

Docker packages applications into containers. A Docker image is a read-only template that holds the code and dependencies. Containers share the host kernel and start in seconds. Docker Compose runs multi-container applications with one command.

Pinecone is a managed vector database for similarity search. Vectors are stored with metadata, and a query returns the nearest neighbours by cosine similarity. Pinecone creates serverless indexes that scale automatically.
Groq serves large language models with very low latency. Its language processing units run inference fast, so chat completions return in milliseconds. Groq offers a free tier for developers.
FastAPI is a modern Python web framework for building APIs. It validates requests automatically from type hints and generates OpenAPI documentation. FastAPI runs on top of Starlette and Uvicorn.
